title: luscious crunchy spanish cheese catalan cream
description: a comforting spanish dessert featuring crispy cheddar cheese and catalan cream, inspired by traditional crema catalana.
instructions: in a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and kosher salt.
in a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and melted butter.
add the grated cheddar cheese to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and whisk until just combined.
pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
drizzle the caramel sauce over the top of the cream and sprinkle with cinnamon.
return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the caramel is bubbly and the cream is set.
remove the dish from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
